name: Three-position maintained selector
summary: A three-position maintained selector stays at the selected position until manually moved.
description: A three-position maintained selector stays at the selected position until manually moved. The schematic needs a contact-state schedule covering all three positions so modes such as local, off and remote are unambiguous.
readingNotes: Read each contact against the complete position table rather than the operator label alone.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: Three maintained positions differ from a selector that spring-returns to centre.
